sloka: स दुरात्मा समुद्यम्य कालदण्डोपमां गदाम् ।प्रविवेश ततः सैन्यं नयन्यक्षान्यमक्षयम् ।। ७.१४.१४ ॥
transliteration: sa durātmā samudyamya kāladaṇḍopamāṁ gadām ।praviveśa tataḥ sainyaṁ nayanyakṣānyamakṣayam ।। 7.14.14 ॥

translations.english: The evil-minded one, having raised his mace resembling the staff of Yama, then entered the army, leading the Yakshas to their death.
